changeSet.author: welcome-home
changeSet.comment: A Nuki connection is either an API token the owner pasted or an OAuth2 authorization. The token sent to Nuki, either one, is access_token_encrypted; an OAuth2 authorization also keeps its refresh token, encrypted the same way, and when its access token expires. Breaks the 1.x releases, which read api_token_encrypted: version 2.0.0.
changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE nuki_connection ADD CONSTRAINT nuki_connection_credential_check CHECK ( (credential = 'API_TOKEN' AND refresh_token_encrypted IS NULL AND access_token_expires_at IS NULL) OR (credential = 'OAUTH2' AND refresh_token_encrypted IS NOT NULL AND access_token_expires_at IS NOT NULL));

rollback.sql: ALTER TABLE nuki_connection DROP CONSTRAINT nuki_connection_credential_check;
